feed.title: AI Benefits Database: feed of new and revised cases

entry.title: An AI companion is being developed for style reflection
entry.summary: Yourcore’s founder describes AI-assisted app development and an intended style companion; benefits to users’ wellbeing or consumption remain unmeasured.

entry.title: AI generates property images for design discussions
entry.summary: DIY Render’s EDIT generates and revises property images for design discussions; faster sales and measured time savings remain unverified.

entry.title: Caseworkers report easier reporting and case handling
entry.summary: Staff in Representative Moulton’s office report easier workflows with Civic Revere, but the interview does not separate AI from conventional software improvements.

entry.title: Virginia tests AI to help agencies review regulations
entry.summary: Vulcan Justinian analyzes Virginia regulations, but the reviewed reporting does not establish how much AI contributes to claimed economic savings.

entry.title: StratLoom uses AI within instructional workflows
entry.summary: StratLoom describes AI-assisted curriculum work and supervised prompt practice; its public sources do not establish improvements in learning or educator efficiency.

entry.title: Voters receive an AI assistant for researching their ballots
entry.summary: VoteMate provides conversational ballot research, while improvements in voter knowledge and participation remain unmeasured in the reviewed sources.

entry.title: A retailer predicts style preferences from consented data
entry.summary: Open Data Labs says that an unnamed retailer improved fashion-preference prediction using consented data; the provider supplies no accuracy values or independent evaluation.

entry.title: A proposal links records to support people facing homelessness
entry.summary: A Darkriderdesign submission proposes Copilot-assisted record synthesis for social workers; this review found no external account of implementation or results.

entry.title: AI copy appears among campaign ads with high click rates
entry.summary: BattlegroundAI reports that its AI copy appeared among school-board campaigns’ strongest ads, without establishing an effect on turnout or election results.

entry.title: GrantRail demonstrates AI support for grant decisions
entry.summary: GrantRail demonstrates intended AI support for education-grant decisions using synthetic data; its displayed portfolio figures are not real outcomes.

entry.title: An AI interface connects users to library collections
entry.summary: Northeastern’s library connected Claude to scholarly collections and reported better discovery in early use; learning gains have not been measured.

entry.title: XR Guild proposes an AI librarian for ethics resources
entry.summary: XR Guild proposes an AI librarian to find ethics resources; public catalog pages also show ChatGPT-attributed keywords, but improved discovery remains unmeasured.

entry.title: HumCat proposes AI support for catastrophe prevention
entry.summary: KYield proposes HumCat for organizational risk prevention, but the reviewed sources do not document a catastrophe that it prevented.

entry.title: KoBold used AI to characterize the Mingomba copper deposit
entry.summary: KoBold combined AI with geological expertise to characterize Mingomba; the sources do not isolate AI’s effect on discovery, costs, or environmental impact.

entry.title: AI animated archival photographs for a historical film
entry.summary: Giovanni Abitante used generative video to animate archival photographs for I Am an American; educational effects have not been measured.

entry.title: Synthetic personas help teams explore market questions
entry.summary: Cambium offers conversations with synthetic personas to help teams explore prices, messages, and product ideas; research accuracy and business benefits remain unverified.

entry.title: SpeciesNet supports ecological estimates with some species missed
entry.summary: Researchers used MegaDetector and SpeciesNet to produce ecological estimates similar to expert analysis for many species, while some species were missed or misclassified.

entry.title: Snake researchers review fewer images with MegaDetector
entry.summary: MegaDetector removed 94% of images from manual review in a Florida study, but the hybrid workflow detected fewer snake events overall.

entry.title: Doctors found a nurse’s brain bleed with help from AI
entry.summary: Julie Knichel’s doctors received an alert after software, apparently Viz.ai, detected her brain bleed.

entry.title: Lifeguards and a fellow swimmer rescued an unconscious man
entry.summary: Lynxight sent his location and images from the pool’s cameras to a lifeguard’s smartwatch.

entry.title: COMPOSER sepsis alerts are linked to lower mortality
entry.summary: At UC San Diego, mortality after COMPOSER deployment was 9.49%, versus a modeled 11.39% without it.

entry.title: Taiwan AI-ECG alerts reduce mortality in a randomized trial
entry.summary: A Taiwanese randomized trial involving 15,965 patients found 90-day mortality of 3.6% with AI-ECG alerts versus 4.3% with usual care.

entry.title: UDK fraud models may have yielded 135, 36 and 72 cases
entry.summary: UDK/ATP ML fraud models (about 60 since 2019): 2023 figures of 135, 36 and 72 cases with revenue from three models; Amnesty (Nov 2024) calls their effectiveness questionable.

entry.title: Huawei digital twin's window alert comes from a sensor, not AI
entry.summary: A Huawei-hosted launch on 25 Feb 2021 presented a window-opening alert sent to a guard's wristband. Knews and Jiefang Daily say that a window sensor detected it; the story is retold with three dates.

entry.title: Face matches reported in a search for missing children
entry.summary: The ministry reported 2,930 facial matches among children in care. The Delhi High Court later recorded that the software had not helped solve any missing-child case.

entry.title: Dexcom G6's Urgent Low Soon alert may cut time below 54 mg/dL
entry.summary: Dexcom-authored analyzes (1,424 and 15,000 users) link the 20-minute predictive low alert to less hypoglycemia; an independent 24-person crossover RCT found a reduction only below 2.8 mmol/L.

entry.title: Researchers found 47 known gravitational-wave signals
entry.summary: Researchers used MADGRAV-2D to recover 47 cataloged gravitational-wave signals from LIGO data.

entry.title: ChatGPT helps review MRI literature on intravascular lymphoma
entry.summary: Chinese neurologists used ChatGPT to help review published MRI findings of cerebral intravascular large B-cell lymphoma for a 59-year-old's case report; the diagnosis came from biopsy, not the model.

entry.title: An implanted interface restored communication for nearly seven years
entry.summary: A woman with locked-in ALS used the Utrecht NeuroProsthesis to communicate at home for nearly seven years.

entry.title: Anthropic flag on a shooting threat leads to a Florida arrest
entry.summary: Anthropic safeguards flagged a threat to shoot up a Florida sheriff's office; reviewers tipped police, who arrested the user; no gun found.

entry.title: Stanford's Tutor CoPilot lifts math mastery 4 percentage points
entry.summary: RCT with 900 tutors and 1,800 grade 3–8 students in a southern US district: students whose tutors had Tutor CoPilot were 4 points more likely to master topics; 9 points for lower-rated tutors.

entry.title: More incoming students complete college enrollment
entry.summary: Among students already committed to Georgia State, Pounce increased enrollment by 3.3 percentage points.

entry.title: Higher algebra scores in the trial’s second year
entry.summary: Students using Cognitive Tutor Algebra I scored 0.21 standard deviations higher in the second year, with no statistically significant difference after correction for multiple comparisons.

entry.title: Delhi students improve their math and Hindi scores
entry.summary: Students offered free access to Mindspark centers gained 0.37 standard deviations in math and 0.23 in Hindi over 4.5 months.

entry.title: o3-assisted reanalysis yields 11 new diagnoses and seven rediscoveries
entry.summary: AI-assisted reanalysis of 376 locally unresolved cases yielded 18 confirmed diagnoses. Eleven were new, while seven had already been established elsewhere.

entry.title: Sheng Siong's facial recognition catches a repeat wine thief
entry.summary: Sheng Siong's facial recognition matched a wine thief to six prior thefts and flagged her return; arrest, restitution, eight days' jail.

entry.title: Wiz finds a critical GitHub RCE with Claude Code and IDA MCP
entry.summary: Wiz's AI-aided reverse engineering found a critical GitHub RCE (CVE-2026–3854); github.com was patched the same day, no exploitation found.

entry.title: Locust control fed by eLocust3m may have averted USD 1.56 billion
entry.summary: PlantVillage's app, built with FAO in under a month in 2020, gathered 240,000+ records; AI removed unusable data; FAO credits the tech-enabled operation with averting USD 1.56 billion in losses.

entry.title: Medicare withholds $4.41 billion in suspected fraudulent payments
entry.summary: Federal analysts flagged unusual billing, and HHS-OIG and CMS held $4.41 billion in escrow during Operation Gold Rush.

entry.title: More loan approvals at lower rates in a simulation
entry.summary: Upstart estimated 27% more approvals and 16% lower annual percentage rates in a simulation. A 2024 independent review found approval disparities for Black applicants.

entry.title: A third company linked to suspected money laundering
entry.summary: Bank F’s network tool found phone numbers and email addresses shared by three companies. Further account checks indicated possible money laundering.

entry.title: Flint uses predictions to find hazardous water pipes
entry.summary: ActiveRemediation helped Flint prioritize homes for inspection and replacement of lead or galvanized-steel service lines.

entry.title: thynC flags ventricular tachycardia; CPR restores circulation
entry.summary: thynC alarm flagged ventricular tachycardia in an 85-year-old on a Gwangju general ward; staff CPR restored circulation, 14 January 2026.

entry.title: LEADERG's AI door god flags smoke; temple fire held to 10 m²
entry.summary: AI camera analytics flagged smoke in an empty temple office a minute before a battery fire; held to 10 m², no injuries, main hall intact.

entry.title: STAR finds two motile sperm; couple conceives after 19 years
entry.summary: STAR AI found 7 sperm (2 motile) in 2.5m images of a “sperm-free” sample; a couple infertile for 19 years conceived and had a girl.

entry.title: Frankfurt camera AI finds a missing 16-year-old within a day
entry.summary: Frankfurt police found a missing 16-year-old in crisis within a day via a court-backed AI face search of Bahnhofsviertel cameras.

entry.title: HelioLinc3D finds asteroid 2022 SF289 in sparse ATLAS detections
entry.summary: HelioLinc3D linked sparse ATLAS detections into PHA 2022 SF289, published by the Minor Planet Center in MPEC 2023-O26 (Jul 2023).

entry.title: ChatGPT names an insulinoma doctors missed for three years
entry.summary: ChatGPT suggested an insulinoma after three undiagnosed years; a glucose sensor and ER blood tests confirmed it and surgery cured him.

entry.title: An early resistance warning helped doctors change a woman’s antibiotic
entry.summary: An early resistance warning from CMUH’s Intelligent Anti-Microbial System helped doctors change a 78-year-old woman’s antibiotic before she recovered.

entry.title: Pregnant women gain knowledge and receive more recommended care
entry.summary: Women invited to PROMPTS improved several measures of knowledge, preparation for childbirth, and reported care by 0.06–0.09 standard deviations.

entry.title: More mothers keep listening to health messages
entry.summary: mMitra’s call scheduler reduced cumulative engagement drops by 32% compared with regular messaging alone over seven weeks.

entry.title: Google Flood Hub triggers pay $105 to 4,600 people in Kogi
entry.summary: Google Flood Hub forecast triggers paid $105 to 4,600 people in Ibaji, Kogi State, mostly before floods peaked on 21 October 2024

entry.title: NHC blends DeepMind's ensemble into Hurricane Melissa forecasts
entry.summary: NHC blended Google DeepMind's AI ensemble into official Melissa forecasts from its first advisory on 21 October 2025; Cat 5 landfall in Jamaica 28 October 2025.

entry.title: An AI eye exam increased screening among young people with diabetes
entry.summary: In the ACCESS trial, all 81 young people offered IDx-DR completed an eye exam, compared with 18 of 82 controls referred to an eye-care provider.

entry.title: People with severe paralysis regained control of a computer at home
entry.summary: Two people with ALS regained control of a computer at home using Stentrode and eye tracking.

entry.title: Fabric GEM flags ANTXR2 and diagnoses an infant in five days
entry.summary: AI-assisted rapid genome sequencing scored a homozygous ANTXR2 variant at 4.7, diagnosing an infant within five days and changing her care plan.

entry.title: AlphaFold models cover over 90% of the human NPC scaffold
entry.summary: Researchers combined AI predictions with electron-microscopy maps to model more than 90% of the human nuclear pore scaffold.

entry.title: An arthritis drug helped patients with severe COVID-19
entry.summary: Researchers used the Benevolent Platform to identify baricitinib as a candidate treatment for COVID-19.

entry.title: A physics tutor more than doubled students’ median learning gains
entry.summary: Harvard students who used PS2 Pal, powered by GPT-4-0613, learned more in less time than students in an active-learning class.

entry.title: IBM–Yamagata AI survey confirms 303 new Nazca geoglyphs in Peru
entry.summary: An IBM–Yamagata deep-learning survey guided fieldwork that confirmed 303 new Nazca geoglyphs, published in PNAS (Sep 2024).
